title: Data driven non-equilibrium moist phase exchanges for atmospheric convection within a discontinuous Galerkin model of the compressible Euler equations
summary: A discrete formulation of the multiphase moist compressible Euler equations is presented for which the energy and tracer variance conserving dynamics is coupled to the non-equilibrium moist phase exchanges in a thermodynamically consistent manner. A neural network is then trained to learn the mass exchanges between vapour, liquid and ice phases in atmospheric convection. The network is trained on convection resolving output from a regional configuration of the LFRic model with a multi-moment microphysics parameterisation (CASIM).
